composing_text: SS-Panzer Regiment 10; SS-Panzergrenadier Regiments 21 and 22; SS-Panzer Artillery Regiment 10; SS-Reconnaissance Battalion 10; SS-Anti-Aircraft Battalion 10; SS-Panzer Pioneer Battalion 10
notes: Counter-attacked 29 June with 9th SS on the west flank of the British salient; attack largely spent by nightfall; attacks continued on 30 June.

location_qualifier: front southwest of Caen; Hill 112 sector as an approximation
source_locator: R601: Einsatz und Unterstellung (17 July 1944 entry); R594: footnote 2 to the II SS Panzer Corps list; R593: p. 326
current_activity: 10th SS Panzer Division being relieved at the front southwest of Caen by the 271st Infantry Division; OB West offers it to the LXXXIV Corps but cannot release it
notes: Event date: Lexikon der Wehrmacht, 271. Infanterie-Division page: "Ab dem 17. Juli 1944 lösten die vordersten Teile die 10. SS-Panzer-Division an der Normandiefront südwestlich von Caen ab"; Nafziger 944BGAA notes the 10th SS Panzer Division "being relieved by the 271st Infantry Division"; Schramm, OKW war diary (p. 326): on 17 July the OB West had put the 10th SS Panzer Division at the disposal of the LXXXIV Corps, but did not carry out the intention because the situation at Caen seemed too threatening. Location: the front southwest of Caen; the point is the dataset place Hill 112 (10th SS Panzer Division, 29 June), with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the sources name the front southwest of Caen, not a place; Hill 112 is the earlier position of the division. Location support: good: two source families (Lexikon and Schramm) agree that the division was still at the Caen front on 17 July. Relationship: the division stays in the II SS Panzer Corps relation CR0052.
